a: a positive integer coordinate of a solution; after fixing k, the notation is relabeled for a minimal-sum solution and ordered so that a is the larger coordinate
b: a positive integer coordinate of a solution; after fixing k, the notation is relabeled for a minimal-sum solution and ordered so that b is the smaller coordinate
X: an indeterminate of the polynomial P
c: the Vieta conjugate integer kb-a of a in the quadratic equation determined by b and k
d: the positive integer -c used under the temporary assumption c<0
u: the first entry of a generic positive-integer solution pair for the fixed k
v: the second entry of a generic positive-integer solution pair for the fixed k
x: the first coordinate of a positive-integer solution chosen with minimal coordinate sum for the fixed value k
y: the second coordinate of that minimal positive-integer solution, ordered so that x is at least y
z: the integer ky-x, the Vieta-conjugate coordinate
a_1: the companion integer root kb-a of P
